_comment: Curated per-trinket reads (card-text pass phase 2, 2026-09-08: 'literally read the text of each card'). base_value = intrinsic power read on the spell-point scale (1 gold = 2 pts, +2/+2 on one minion = 4, recurring per-turn effects priced over ~5-6 turns). synergy = what board/keyword features reward holding this trinket: tribes (canonical), keywords (deathrattle/battlecry/magnetic/divine_shield/reborn/taunt/blood_gem/spell/refresh/economy/leveling/golden/trinket/dark_gift/hero_power/hand/yogg). Consumed by choices._rank_trinkets (precise synergy instead of the substring read) and value.minion_value (W_TRINKET term).
